define: Income tax paid in India during the year the income is earned, in parts, instead of all at once when the return is filed. It is due when a year's tax, after tax deducted at source, comes to ₹10,000 or more.
example: A freelancer whose year's tax after TDS comes to ₹24,000 pays it in parts by 15 June, 15 September, 15 December and 15 March, not all at the end.
